name: EffiProz
tagline: Pure C# embedded SQL engine modelled on HSQLDB, with Silverlight and Windows Phone 7 builds; dead since 2012.
description: EffiProz was an embedded relational database written entirely in C#, with an SQL dialect and feature set closely tracking HSQLDB 1.9/2.0. It ran in-process in .NET, Silverlight 4 and Windows Phone 7 applications, shipped an ADO.NET and Entity Framework provider with Visual Studio 2010 designer support, and let developers write stored functions, aggregates and table-valued functions in CLR languages. A Ms-PL community edition lived on CodePlex alongside commercial builds, and the company was a 2010 Red Herring Global 100 winner. Development stopped around 2012; effiproz.com now hosts unrelated spam, so use the archived CodePlex pages for reference. SQLite (Microsoft.Data.Sqlite) or LiteDB cover the same embedded .NET niche today.
statusNote: Abandoned around 2012; the vendor domain now serves unrelated spam. For embedded .NET use SQLite or LiteDB.

license.name: Microsoft Public License (community edition); commercial editions

pricing.notes: The Ms-PL community edition was free; commercial editions are no longer sold.

strengths: Fully managed C# code: no native binaries, so it ran inside the Silverlight and Windows Phone 7 sandboxes
Rich SQL inherited from HSQLDB, plus CLR user-defined functions, aggregates and TVFs
Entity Framework provider and Visual Studio 2010 tooling
weaknesses: Dead since about 2012; targets platforms (Silverlight, WP7) that are themselves gone
Original site and source host have disappeared
Small user base; little documentation survives
useCases: Historical reference for managed-code embedded SQL engines
Maintaining very old Silverlight or WP7 apps that bundled it
